name: Linnorm Hunter Style [Combat, Selfless, Style, Teamwork]
body:
You and your animal companion work together to make coordinated strikes against your enemies.

Prerequisite(s): Cha 13, must have or be an animal companion.

Benefit(s): Once per round while using this style, when you hit a target that both you and your ally threaten using a melee attack, your ally gains a +2 bonus on attacks of opportunity made against that target for 1 round. Enemies that provoke attacks of opportunity from you also provoke attacks of opportunity from your ally so long as they threaten them (even if the situation or an ability would normally deny you the attack of opportunity).

Special: Animal companions with an Intelligence score of 1 or 2 can take this feat.
